'''Alviri-Vidari''' ([[Tati language (Iran)|Tati]]: {{lang|fa|الویری-ویدری}}) is a dialect of the [[Tati language (Iran)|Tati language]]<ref>{{Glottolog|alvi1241|Alviri-Vidari}}</ref><ref>Stilo, D. 1981: "The Tati dialects in the Sociolinguistic Context of Northwestern Iran and Transcaucasia" In: ''Iranian Studies'' 14.3/4, 137-187.</ref><ref>[https://archive.org/download/alviriyarshater/Dr.Yarshater-AlvirVidar.pdf  Dialects of Alvir and Vidar, Professor Yarshater, 1969.]</ref><ref>[https://archive.org/stream/HeningTati/2011_6_10-theAncientLanguageOfAzerbaijan_djvu.txt  Tati, W. B. Henning.]</ref><ref>Tats of Iran and Caucasus, Ali Abdoli, 2010.</ref> spoken in [[Iran]], near [[Saveh]] in the [[Markazi Province]]. [[Alvir]] and [[Vidar, Markazi|Vidar]] are the villages of its speakers.
